examples.reply:
```flowproof
# Five isolated attempts, graded by frozen tests, chosen by tests, behaviour, then patch votes.
workflow five_attempts
  needs issue: text
  role author can edit
  budget at most 5 calls

  fork 5 isolated into attempts
    let patch = edit author: """
      Fix this issue: {issue}
      Attempt {branch} of 5.
      """
    keep patch
  end

  let graded = test attempts with "npm test" frozen "test/**", "package.json"
  let best = choose graded by tests, then behaviour, then votes else first
  give best
end
```
